content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Candidate already holding same/equivalent post in the same pay level OR Superintendents having Master's Degree/LLB with ten years of experience out of which at least five years as superintendent in the University. Hindi/Sanskrit up to matric standard or at higher level. Experience required: 10 years experience out of which at least 5 years as superintendent in the University. Pay: FPL-10. Qualification required: Candidate already holding same/equivalent post in the same pay level OR Graduate with minimum 60% marks at metric or 50% marks at 10+2 level with having 02 years' experience s Daftri and Group D employee 05 years' experience in the university with minimum qualification of 10+2 or above. All applicant should have already cleared the SETC examinaton. Experience required: 02 years experience as Daftri and Group D employee 05 years experience in the university. Pay: FPL-2.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The selection on deputation shall be on temporary basis for a period of one years or till vacancy is filled on regular basis whichever is earlier

content_sections.text: Scrutiny Interview University reserve right to conduct any test for shortlisting of candidates for Scrutiny/interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested photo copy of Matric showing Date of Birth Self-attested photo copy of essential qualifications and above/diploma/degree Self-attested photo copy of Experience Certificate No vigilance case/departmental proceedings/court case certificate ACRs for the last 10/available years duly attested Integrity certificate No major/minor penalties certificate

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GUG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GUG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies: 2 Assistant Registrar, 7 Clerk-cum-DEO.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GUG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 12 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: FPL-10 for Assistant Registrar, FPL-2 for Clerk-cum-DEO.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree / Graduation / Matric with experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Working on regular basis in Central/State Universities/ Govt. organization. On deputation basis as per standard terms & conditions of the Haryana State Govt/Gurugram University. Hindi/Sanskrit up to matric standard.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates not fulfilling eligibility conditions on the cutoff date need not apply.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny. Interview. University reserve right to conduct any test for shortlisting of candidates for Scrutiny/interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection on deputation shall be on temporary basis for a period of one years or till vacancy is filled on regular basis whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Gurugram.
